sn55.21:1.2: ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Sakkesu viharati Kapilavatthusmiṃ Nigrodhārāme || || 2.
sn55.21:1.3: Atha kho Mahānāmo sakko yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Mahānāmo sakko Bhagavantam etad avoca || || 3.
sn55.21:1.4: Idam bhante Kapilavatthu iddhaṃ ceva phitañca bahujanam ākiṇṇamanussam sambādhavyūhaṃ || ||
sn55.21:1.5: So khvāham bhante Bhagavantaṃ vā payirupāsitvā manobhāvanīye vā bhikkhū sāyaṇhasamayaṃ Kapilavatthum pavisanto
sn55.21:1.11: tassa mayham bhante tasmiṃ samaye mussateva Bhagavantam ārabbha sati || mussati dhammam arabbha sati || mussati saṅgham ārabbha sati || ||
sn55.21:1.13: Imamhi cāhaṃ samaye kālaṃ kareyyaṃ kā mayhaṃ gati ko abhisamparāyo ti || || 4.
sn55.21:2.1: Mā bhāyi Mahānāma mā bhāyi Mahānāma ||
sn55.21:2.2: apāpakaṃ te maraṇam bhavissati apāpikā kālaṃkiriyā || ||
sn55.21:2.3: Yassa kassaci Mahānāma dīgharattaṃ saddhāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ sīlaparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ sutaparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ cāgaparibhāvitaṃ cittam paññaparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ || tassa yo hi khvāyaṃ kāyo rūpī cātumahābhūtiko mātāpittikasambhavo odanakummāsupacayo aniccucchādanaparimaddana-bhedana-viddhaṃsanadhammo
sn55.21:2.4: tam idheva kākā vā khādanti gijjhā vā khādanti kulalā vā khādanti sunakhā vā khādanti sigālā va khādanti vividhā vā pāṇakajātā khādanti || ||
sn55.21:2.5: Yañca khvassa cittaṃ dīgharattaṃ saddhāparibhāvitam sīla-suta-cāga-paribhāvitaṃ || tam uddhagāmi hoti visesagāmi || || 5.
sn55.21:3.1: Seyyathāpi Mahānāma puriso sappikumbham vā telakumbham vā gambhīram udakarahadam ogāhetvā bhindeyya ||
sn55.21:3.2: tatra yā assa sakkharā vā kaṭhalā vā sā adhogāmī assa || yañca khvassa tatra sappi vā telaṃ vā tam uddhaṃgāmī assa visesāgamī || ||
sn55.21:3.3: Evam eva kho Mahānāma yassa kassaci dīgharattaṃ saddhāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ sīlasuta-cāga-
sn55.21:3.4: paññāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ || tassa hoti khvāyam kāyo rūpī cātumahābhūtiko mātāpittikasambhavo odanakummāsupacayo aniccucchādana-parimaddana-bhedanaviddhaṃsanadhammo || tam idheva kākā vā khādanti || gijjhā vā khā- || kulalā vā khā- || sunakhā vā khā- || sigālā vā khā- || vividhā vā pāṇakajātā khādanti || ||
sn55.21:3.5: Yañca khvassa taṃ cittaṃ dīgharattaṃ saddhāparibhāvitaṃ sīla-suttacāgapaññā paribhāvitaṃ || tam uddhaṃgāmī hoti visesagāmī || || 6.
sn55.21:3.6: Tuyhaṃ kho pana Mahānama dīgharattaṃ saddhaparibhāvitaṃ cittam sīla-suta-cāga-paññāparibhāvitaṃ cittam ||
sn55.21:3.7: mā bhāyi Mahānāma mā bhāyi Mahānāma
sn55.21:3.8: apāpakaṃ te maraṇam bhavissati apāpikā kālakiriyā
